description: Files under public/ that no hash-pinning manifest covers. scripts/prepare-distribution.mjs fails the build on any other file there: moon textures are pinned by moon_texture_attribution.json, lazy moon shards by moon-ephemerides/manifest.json, and the Phase 1 asteroid binary by its .meta.json. Add a file only after reviewing its source and licence (docs/distribution-policy.md), and update its hash when a reviewed edit changes it.
